pair_scope: Same split and same genotype block only; never train/development or test pairs.
variance_rule: Fit pooled within-genotype sample variance using eligible training genotypes only. Effective variance of each mean is max(its sample variance, training pooled variance)/replicate count.
preference_rule: Choose the higher recomputed H1 mean only when its gap strictly exceeds both minimum_mean_gap and uncertainty_multiplier times sqrt(effective variance of each mean summed). This is a heuristic uncertainty screen, not a calibrated hypothesis test or simultaneous confidence guarantee.
pair_sampling: Seeded random disjoint matchings within each block for at most 64 rounds; accept eligible, previously unseen pairs while both endpoints have degree below eight. Selection never uses model scores.
weighting: Each represented variant has equal total contribution within its block; each represented block has equal weight. Pair weight is (1/degree_chosen + 1/degree_rejected)/(represented variants in block * represented blocks). Weights sum to one per split.
evaluation_scope: Use the existing 512 scored development genotypes. Report weighted pair accuracy, paired differences, per-block results, leave-one-block-out ranges, and measured top-K. Three development blocks do not support a reliable confirmatory cluster confidence interval; no independent-pair binomial interval is used.
